issues.description: Silent default change from EXTERNAL to FIXED is a behavioral break for existing callers.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flagged the default flip on turn_detection_mode. Callers who omitted the parameter now get different endpointing semantics with no code change on their side. Either keep EXTERNAL as default, or surface this as a breaking change in the changelog and docs with an explicit migration note rather than filing it under 'fixed'.

issues.description: EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED referenced without visible import or evidence it exists in the SDK.
issues.detail: The membership test against EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED in _enable_vad has no corresponding import or enum definition in the diff. If the installed speechmatics package lacks this value, construction raises AttributeError. Show the SDK 0.0.99 evidence or add the import explicitly.

issues.description: _enable_vad conflates multiple concerns and the warning-then-fallthrough branch is unstructured.
issues.detail: One boolean now governs VAD frame emission, acceptance of VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame for finalization, and a warning branch. The `elif not self._enable_vad` is a double-negative trap encoding a state machine via flags. Decompose into named predicates (e.g. emits_vad_frames, accepts_external_finalize) derived from the mode enum, or route frames at the dispatcher so the handler only sees frames it should act on.

issues.description: split_sentences default coerced via `or False` collapses tri-state bool | None semantics.
issues.detail: params.split_sentences is declared bool | None = None but written as `params.split_sentences or False`, conflating None and False. Either honor None as 'use SDK default' and skip the write, or change the schema default to False explicitly. Don't paper over the distinction at the write site.

issues.description: speech_segment_config unconditionally overwritten, discarding prior values and SDK defaults.
issues.detail: The code wholesale replaces config.speech_segment_config even when split_sentences is None, stomping whatever the SDK or generic loop set. If SpeechSegmentConfig later grows fields, callers lose them silently. Construct once with all known fields, or skip the write when there's nothing to set.

issues.description: Commented-out start_processing_metrics line moved without being deleted or restored.
issues.detail: A commented `await self.start_processing_metrics()` was relocated within _handle_start_of_turn with no functional change. Either uncomment and own the metrics call as part of the spec, or delete it. Leaving relocated dead code in the diff encodes an unresolved decision and wastes review attention.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this PR needs work. The headline issue is a silent default change from EXTERNAL to FIXED on turn_detection_mode that breaks existing callers and is mislabeled as a fix. EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED is referenced without visible import evidence, risking AttributeError at construction. The _enable_vad boolean complects multiple concerns and the warning-then-fallthrough branch encodes an unstructured state machine. Smaller issues include the `or False` coercion collapsing bool | None, unconditional speech_segment_config overwrite, and a relocated commented-out metrics line that should be owned or deleted.
